Refund_not_showing_up: Customer was told a refund was issued or asked a merchant for one, and the money has not appeared in their account yet.
activate_my_card: Customer has a new card and wants to know how to activate it or is trying to activate it.
age_limit: Asks about the minimum age to open an account, or whether children or teenagers can have an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Questions or problems about using Apple Pay or Google Pay with the account or card, including top-ups through them.
atm_support: Asks which ATMs can be used or where the card can withdraw cash from a machine.
automatic_top_up: Asks about the auto top-up feature: how to set it up, how it works, or problems with it.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Customer sent a bank transfer into their account and the balance still does not show the money.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque or cash and the balance has not gone up yet.
beneficiary_not_allowed: Customer cannot add a recipient/beneficiary, or a transfer to a beneficiary is not permitted.
cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel or undo a transfer they already made, for example sent to the wrong account or by mistake.
card_about_to_expire: The card expires soon and the customer asks what to do or how to get a replacement for the expiring card.
card_acceptance: Asks where the card is accepted, or which shops and places will take the card.
card_arrival: Customer ordered a card and it has not arrived yet, or asks how to track a card that is already on its way.
card_delivery_estimate: Asks how long card delivery takes or when a card would arrive, as a general timing question, including choosing a delivery date or faster delivery.
card_linking: Customer wants to link or re-add an existing card (for example a found or new card) to the app.
card_not_working: The physical card does not work in general: it is broken, damaged or fails everywhere, with no specific declined payment described.
card_payment_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee for paying with the card and asks why.
card_payment_not_recognised: There is a card payment on the statement that the customer does not recognise or did not make.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card payment in a foreign currency used an exchange rate the customer thinks is wrong.
card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the customer's card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: Customer was charged a fee for withdrawing cash from an ATM and asks why.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: There is an ATM cash withdrawal on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not make.
change_pin: Customer wants to change their card PIN and asks how or where.
compromised_card: Customer thinks their card details were stolen, copied or used by someone else while they still have the card.
contactless_not_working: Contactless (tap) payments are failing while other ways of paying may still work.
country_support: Asks which countries the service or card is available in, or whether it works/ships to a given country.
declined_card_payment: A specific card payment in a shop or online was declined and the customer asks why.
declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal attempt was declined or refused.
declined_transfer: A transfer the customer tried to send was declined or rejected.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: There is a direct debit on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not set up.
disposable_card_limits: Asks about limits on disposable virtual cards: how many can be made or how much they can be used.
edit_personal_details: Customer wants to change personal details such as name, address, phone number or email.
exchange_charge: Asks about fees for exchanging currencies, or was charged a fee for a currency exchange.
exchange_rate: Asks what exchange rate is used, how rates are set, or what rate they will get.
exchange_via_app: Asks how to exchange one currency for another inside the app, or whether that is possible.
extra_charge_on_statement: Customer sees an extra or unexplained fee/charge on their statement and asks what it is, without saying it is from a card payment, transfer, top-up or withdrawal specifically.
failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through, and the customer asks why or what happened.
fiat_currency_support: Asks which traditional currencies are supported for holding or exchanging.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Customer wants to get or create a disposable, single-use virtual card.
get_physical_card: Customer has an account (maybe only a virtual card) and asks how to get the physical plastic card, or asks where their PIN for it is.
getting_spare_card: Customer wants an additional or second card, for themselves or a family member.
getting_virtual_card: Customer wants to get a (non-disposable) virtual card and asks how.
lost_or_stolen_card: Customer's card was lost or stolen and they need to block or replace it.
lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer's phone was lost or stolen and they worry about account access or need to secure it.
order_physical_card: Customer wants to order a physical card now, or asks about ordering cost and process.
passcode_forgotten: Customer forgot their app passcode or cannot log in because of it and wants to reset it.
pending_card_payment: A card payment shows as pending for a long time and the customer asks why or when it completes.
pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending and the customer asks why.
pending_top_up: A top-up shows as pending or has not completed yet.
pending_transfer: A transfer the customer sent shows as pending and the customer asks why or how long it takes to complete.
pin_blocked: Customer entered the wrong PIN too many times and the PIN or card is now blocked.
receiving_money: Asks how to receive money into the account, for example salary or payments from other people.
request_refund: Customer wants to get a refund for something they bought and asks how to request it.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reversed or the money came back to the account unexpectedly, and the customer asks why.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Asks which cards and currencies can be used to top up or add money.
terminate_account: Customer wants to close or delete their account.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Asks whether topping up by bank transfer costs a fee, or was charged for it.
top_up_by_card_charge: Asks whether topping up by card costs a fee, or was charged a fee for a card top-up.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Asks whether or how they can top up using cash or a cheque.
top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed, was declined or did not work.
top_up_limits: Asks about limits on how much or how often they can top up.
top_up_reverted: A top-up went through and then was reversed or the money was taken back.
topping_up_by_card: Asks how to top up using a card, or general questions about adding money by card where nothing has failed.
transaction_charged_twice: The same payment appears twice or the customer was charged twice for one purchase.
transfer_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee for a transfer and asks why, or asks about transfer fees.
transfer_into_account: Asks how to transfer money into their own account from another bank or account.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer sent money and the recipient says it has not arrived.
transfer_timing: Asks how long transfers take in general, or when a transfer will arrive, as a timing question.
unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or not working for the customer.
verify_my_identity: Asks how to verify their identity or what documents are needed.
verify_source_of_funds: Asked to prove where their money comes from, or asks about source-of-funds checks.
verify_top_up: Asks about verifying a top-up, or a top-up needs a verification step such as a code.
virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card is not working or is being rejected.
visa_or_mastercard: Asks whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or wants to choose between them.
why_verify_identity: Asks why identity verification is required at all, or objects to having to do it.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM gave the customer a different amount of cash than was requested or debited.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A foreign-currency ATM withdrawal used an exchange rate the customer thinks is wrong.
